name: Spaceship 5e1adb91 on 3.12.12
description: A period-8 spaceship on the truncated hexagonal tiling 3.12.12 (touching neighbours), 12 to 23 cells, moving four lattice steps every 8 generations (c/2). It runs the same way in the 1,024 rules from B26/S26 to B2,6,8,9,10,11,12/S2,6,7,9,10,11,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen once). A derivative ship (852ea9ff with a tag-along): kept as a distinct object, not counted as a discovery.
